2. Corner list

Two frames. The scenery and the brief use the AUTHORING frame (the OSM v0 origin); def.turns, sectors and the HUD use the RACING frame, which starts at the game's start line. They differ by SL = 1 − _sceneryShift = 0.1636 of a lap: racing = authoring − 0.1636 (mod 1). I checked every brief corner this way and each lands within 0.0001 of a def.turns entry (measured, VM). The def itself carries no names; the names below come from the brief's fractions. Radius = tightest of ±6 nodes (≈4 m spacing). Direction uses +k = left.

4b. Code and scenery deep-dive

Read in full: js/circuits/brands_hatch.js (72 lines), js/circuits/scenery/brands_hatch.js (930), docs/tracks/brands_hatch.md, nested js/circuits/CLAUDE.md. Real-world facts are cited from the brief only (racingcircuits.info, Wikipedia, MSV venue doc, oversteer48); I did not re-fetch them this pass.

Coordinate frames (the key to reading this file)

  • sceneryCoordinates: "racing" (def:42) but the dressing was authored on the old v0 origin; sceneryStartFrac: 0 + startFrac 0.1226 give _sceneryShift = 0.8364 (measured). K(f) takes AUTHORING fracs. sl(f) = (f + 0.1636) % 1 (scenery:300–302) re-keys the start-line complex (pits, gantries, four named stands, Kentagon) so it travels with the line; everything else stays on its real corners (block 1 banking, woods, furniture).
  • Authoring → racing: subtract 0.1636. Examples: Druids terraces 0.054–0.095 → racing 0.89–0.93 (turn 11, R 34 m; the file's "built R ~40 m over 0.071..0.084" comment matches). Woods WOODS_A 0.378 … WOODS_B 0.845 → racing 0.214 … 0.681 (turn 2 to turn 8).
  • def.turns, sectors, HUD sectors are racing-frame; the brief's fractions are authoring-frame (see section 2).

5. Screenshot gallery: weather × time of day × lap position

Orbit camera (az 35°, el 30°, 75 m), 1280×720 TLX, SwiftShader (no real GPU), HUD off, track frozen, JPEGs downscaled to 800 px. Weather applied with weather(w), time with setTimeOfDay(t). Eye-level and corner frames follow the grid.

Day / dry

Reference look. Flat green far-field with a hard horizon; dark wedge-shaped ridge polygons at the horizon in 0.17/0.83 (upper right). Pit-building roof fills the 0.00 orbit frame. Racing-line arrows are the default assist overlay, not scenery.

Day / overcast

Hazy: distant trees fade, white cloud-like smudges lie on the far plain, grass and road are darker than dry. Ridge wedges are still visible at the horizon.

Day / fog

Fog is the best weather response here: trees fade with depth, horizon blends, ridge wedges are hidden. Fog patches read as scattered white blobs on the far plain.

Day / wet (after day-wet-lighting merge)

Re-shot after merging cursor/day-wet-lighting-b7b8: dim and green-grey but readable; road wet-dark, no rain streaks.

Day / rain (after day-wet-lighting merge)

Re-shot after the merge. The first pass (before it) was night-dark and blue and the far plain read as open water; now it is a dim grey-green dusk look and the water look is gone. Tree canopies still show dark vertical stripes on the lower tiers (orbit 0.33, 0.50).

Day / storm

Same grade as rain with heavier streaks and mist; far plain flat grey; ridge wedge visible at 0.83 (upper right). Tree stripe artefacts persist.

Dusk / storm

Warm light pools plus rain; bright sun-glint strip on the far plain at orbit 0.17 (top right) still reads as water.

Night / storm

Lamp pools and pit-straight glow; track surface wet-glossy; far field black. Kentagon area glows yellow at 0.00.

Dusk / dry

Warm low sun, golden blotchy light pools on the dirt shoulders (visible blocky texel pattern). Lamp pools appear even though def.furniture.lamp is "none".

Dusk / rain

Sun glint on the far plain (orbit 0.17 and 0.50, upper right) reads as sunlight on open water; blocky orange light pools on the shoulders as in dusk/dry; streaks barely visible.

Night / dry

Lamps and floodlight pools are present on the track edge and pit straight; shoulders show orange blocky pools; sky and far field are black with no horizon cue.

Night / rain

Darker again; glints on the pit-straight roof and car-park cars; headlight-style spots remain.

6. Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

An earlier version of this report (commit 65dfb5b) ranked "layout and corner table wrong" first. That was my frame mix-up and is retracted: see section 2. Tags: measured = frame or VM; suspect = inference.

  1. Start line, pit complex and the Paddock Hill / Hailwoods stands sit about 0.16 lap (≈640 m) after Paddock Hill measured (VM + source). startFrac 0.1226 moved the line to the first R ≥ 1500 m straight (brands_hatch.js:25–33), which is just before Graham Hill (turn 1). Block 2 keys the stands through sl(): Paddock Hill stand anchor(K(sl(0.016))) scenery:385, Hailwoods sl(0.038) :399, Kentagon sl(0.018) :534, pits sl(0.938..1.032) :504–513. Those places are beside the start line (racing 0.016–0.04, y ≈ −12…−15 m), not at the real Paddock Hill (racing 0.851, y −1 m at the lip). So the brief's central feature "falls immediately off the line into Paddock Hill; stand on the lip" is not what the player sees. The bank at Paddock Hill proper is only spectatorHill(0.008, 0.026) :141. Fix (a dressing or new-track call): either re-seat the line on the Paddock Hill straight (Clark → Paddock, needs a longer straight than the R ≥ 1500 rule allows) or move the named stands to K(0.0..0.04) in authoring frame (no sl()), keeping only pits/gantry on the line.
  2. Clark Curve has a 14 m-radius node on 14 m-wide tarmac measured: verify-track min radius 14.31 m at node 727 (racing 0.7487, turn 9 / Clark). Real Clark Curve is a long right (estimate, brief §4). Mechanism: ≈6 OSM points across the corner (brands_hatch.js:69, points [-337.6,-425.8]…[-306.8,-454.9]) give a polygonal kink. Fix: add control points or fit an arc in tools/track/import-circuit-path.mjs; inner edge radius is only 7 m now. Orbit 0.75 shows the U-shape.
  3. Rain and storm: tree canopies show dark vertical stripes measured, in day/rain, day/storm, night/rain after the lighting merge (orbit 0.33, 0.50). Looks like wet-shader or shadow banding on the layered conifer meshes (engine, nature.js trees), not circuit data. Route to renderer-debug; check one other circuit first.
  4. Water-like far plain measured: pre-merge day/rain looked like open water; after the day-wet-lighting merge it is grey, but dusk/storm and dusk/rain still show a bright sun-glint strip on the far plain (orbit 0.17, upper right). Engine/lighting; terrain sheen should not mirror the sun.
  5. Dark wedge ridges at the horizon measured. Dry-day orbit 0.00/0.17/0.83 and corner frames show hard-edged dark or olive triangles. Source: ridge() loop scenery:884–900 (len 340–420, hgt 26–34, 600–780 m out; colour [0.22,0.34,0.19] is darker than the grass [0.18,0.38,0.18] and flat) and mountain() farHill :916–930; build guard drops one mountain (verify warning). Fix: tint toward fogColor, widen the base so the silhouette is not one plane, move the dropped farHill.
  6. Bowl relief is not legible in orbit views measured: the road drops 28 m but the surrounding terrain reads as a flat plane to a hard horizon. Possible cause (suspect): terrainOuter: 110 (brands_hatch.js:43) with terrain following the road only locally. Probe terrainYAt at 60/110/200 m on the −1 side around racing 0.85–0.03 before changing anything.
  7. Night/dusk: blocky light pools and lamp mismatch measured. Orange blotches show a visible texel grid on the shoulders; furniture.lamp: "none" (brands_hatch.js:66) yet lamp heads and pools appear. Engine lighting; the def may simply need lamp set to the rendered style.
  8. Pit complex reads as featureless slabs measured: building(...) ×(14 bays + 11 offices) at scenery:504–513 are box masses with identical heights; the 0.00 orbit and eye frames are half filled by a grey slab. Fix: vary heights and add garage doors via place().
  9. carPark ground fit audit: scenery:113 gives 2 buried (worst 1.30 m), 1 unsupported (1.26 m) and one flat coplanar pair (7.96 m² against :440). The 0.35 m check at :119–121 samples the anchor only; a 4.3 m car on a slope still buries one end. Fix: test head and tail.
  10. Severe clip at frac 0.943 plus minor clips 0.95–0.03 audit (1.12 m frustum×frustum; box×box 0.76–0.93 m). Racing 0.943 is just before the line, so these are pit/gantry/race-control masses (scenery:504–520, gantry(sl(0.972)) :517). Not traced to two emitters; do that first.
  11. Footbridge end columns at ±7 m suspect, not captured: scenery:652 uses anchor(k, ±1, 7), equal to baseHW 7, so columns may stand on the kerb line. Probe with trackside cam at authoring 0.070 (racing 0.907) and 0.430 (racing 0.267).
  12. Tree species suspect: furniture.tree: "broad" and the OAK palette, but most frames show layered conifers; guard drops tree=358 thin the bowl rim.
